g.text: Find the company's own document (annual report, sustainability statement, auditor's statement, data book).
Read the table; when PDF text extraction is ambiguous, check the rendered page or the report's own totals.
Append with pipeline/add_reported.py, including boundary, URL and section.
If nothing usable exists, write the reason and what was checked in emissions_gaps.csv. A blank is never
Aggregators (Tracenable, DitchCarbon) and AI summaries are never used as sources.
